lines.japanese: ──しかし、またしても結果はやっぱりだった。
lines.english: —And once again, the result was exactly what you'd expect.

lines.japanese: 終夜営業のディスカウントストアその周辺に、俺たちの探しているものはなかった。
lines.english: What we were looking for was nowhere around the all-night discount store.

lines.japanese: 「……ま、そう上手くはいかねーよな」
lines.english: “...Well. Wasn't going to be that easy.”

lines.japanese: 「ですよねー」
lines.english: “I suppose not.”

lines.japanese: 馬鹿みたいに明るい照明の下、路面にまでせりだした雑貨の山をなんとなく眺めながら、俺たちは白い息を吐いた。
lines.english: Under lights bright to the point of idiocy, our breath white in the air, we idly surveyed the piles of sundries spilling onto the sidewalk.

lines.japanese: バッタ屋経由としか思えない、二束三文の値で叩き売られているトイレットペーパー、制汗スプレー、アニメキャラの変身ステッキ、数ヵ月前に大々的な広告展開のもと世に出た大手メーカーの炭酸飲料……。
lines.english: Toilet paper, antiperspirant spray, a transformation wand from some anime, a major manufacturer’s soda launched only months ago with an enormous advertising blitz... All of it was being dumped for pennies, as though the stock could only have come through a liquidation broker.

lines.japanese: 店の名前を狂ったように繰りかえす陽気なＢＧＭが、時間帯も顧みないボリュームで垂れながされていた。
lines.english: Cheerful music repeated the store's name with lunatic persistence, pouring out at a volume oblivious to the hour.

lines.japanese: 「にしても……意外と頑張ってんだな、あいつら」
lines.english: “Still... they're working harder than I expected.”

lines.japanese: 俺は９０度横を向いた。
lines.english: I looked off to one side.

lines.japanese: 張り込みのつもりなんだろうか、鳳ンとこのアタマ悪げなガキ共が数人（もちろんさっきのドレッドたちとは別のグループだ）、ガードレールに尻を置いたり缶ビールを呷ったりしていた。
lines.english: Apparently attempting a stakeout, several of Otori's dim-looking brats—a different group from the dreadlocks earlier, naturally—sat on the guardrail or tipped back cans of beer.

lines.japanese: 「あのー」
「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 鳴に呼ばれて向きなおった。やつは意味もなくにこにこと笑っていた。
lines.english: I turned when Naru called me. She was smiling at me for no reason at all.

lines.japanese: 「せっかくですからー、ちょっと寄っていきません？」
lines.english: “Since we've come all this way, shall we stop inside for a little while?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: やつは脳天気な笑顔で俺の方を向いていたが、突きだされた指はまっすぐ閉店知らずの店を差していた。
lines.english: She faced me with that carefree smile, while her outstretched finger pointed directly at the store that never closed.

lines.japanese: 「え、なんか買うの」
lines.english: “You need to buy something?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、買いたいものがあればー」
lines.english: “If I find something I want.”

lines.japanese: 「買いたいもの売ってんの」
lines.english: “Do they sell something you want?”

lines.japanese: 「さー、分かりません見てみないとー」
lines.english: “How would I know until I look?”

lines.japanese: それはつまり──
lines.english: Which meant—

lines.japanese: 「ああ、冷やかし」
lines.english: “Oh. Loitering in the aisles.”

lines.japanese: ──と呼ばれる行為だ。
lines.english: —was the technical term for it.

lines.japanese: 「ウインドウショッピングとも言いますけどー。だめですかー」
lines.english: “One could also call it window-shopping. Is that not allowed?”

lines.japanese: 「だめっつうか、いや、だっておまえ、もうそんな遊んでる時間でもねーだろ」
lines.english: “It isn't about permission. It's too late to be screwing around, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴の左手を掴んで持ちあげた。手首に巻きついた細い女時計を確認する。０時を回ったばかりだった。
lines.english: I caught Naru’s left hand and lifted it to inspect the dainty watch around her wrist. Midnight had just passed.

lines.japanese: 「あーほら、もう日付変わっちゃってんじゃん。あと三十分だろ、終電」
lines.english: “See? It’s past midnight. Your last train’s in half an hour.”

lines.japanese: 「やー、間に合わなかったらタクシーで帰りますのでー」
lines.english: “If I miss it, I can take a taxi home.”

lines.japanese: 「よくねーな、そーゆーの。てめえで稼いだわけでもねえカネ、無駄遣いすんじゃねーよ」
lines.english: “No. That's a rotten habit. Don't waste money you didn't earn yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「そーなんですけどー、なんですけどー、もー、今日だけわがまま聞いてくださいよー」
lines.english: “That is true, but... but please indulge me just for tonight.”

lines.japanese: 「あのさ。なあ。今日だけとか、一生に一度とか、いまどきそんなん小学生みてえな限定条件に説得力があるとでも──」
lines.english: “Listen. You think saying ‘just tonight’ or ‘once in a lifetime’ still has any pull? What are you, a grade-schooler—”

lines.japanese: 「──んだコラ。あァ、なに見てんだてめえら」
lines.english: “—what the hell? Yeah, you assholes. What are you staring at?”

lines.japanese: 女の腕を掴んだまま言いあっていた俺たちは、張り込み中の正義の味方共にニヤニヤ観賞されていた。
lines.english: We had been arguing with my hand still around her wrist, and the champions of justice on stakeout were grinning as they enjoyed the show.

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんなガキ。こっち見んじゃねえよ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Screw you, brats. Quit staring or I’ll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 俺がヤクザキックで宙を蹴って抗議すると、やつらは余計に面白がって、ニヤニヤの中にゲラゲラやウヒョヒョヒョを混ぜはじめた。
lines.english: I protested with a gangster-style kick through empty air. That only delighted them more; guffaws and hooting joined the grins.

lines.japanese: 「サル共が。今日はこのぐらいで勘弁したらァ」
lines.english: “Damn monkeys. I’ll let you off this time.”

lines.japanese: 俺は逃げるように店の中へ突入した。あとから「うはー」とか言いながら付いてくる小娘がいた。
lines.english: I fled into the store. Naru followed behind me with a delighted whoop.

lines.japanese: 「隼人さん、どうですかー」
lines.english: “What do you think, Hayato, sir?”

lines.japanese: 「どうって何が」
lines.english: “What do I think of what?”

lines.japanese: びよんびよん曲がるナイフをびよんびよんさせて遊んでいたら、鳴が奇怪なものを被ってやってきた。
lines.english: I was amusing myself by boinging a bendy toy knife back and forth when Naru approached wearing something bizarre on her head.

lines.japanese: 「やー、隼人さんこういうのお好きじゃないかと思いましてー。ふにゃーッ」
lines.english: “I thought you might like this sort of thing, Hayato. Fnyaa!”

lines.japanese: 俺はびよんびよん曲がるナイフの切っ先を向けてびよんびよん揺らす。
lines.english: I pointed the bendy toy knife at her and wobbled its tip back and forth.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ。おまえさ。兼ねてよりなんか部分的に俺のこと誤解してない」
lines.english: “Listen, you… Have you had some weirdly specific idea about me this whole time?”

lines.japanese: 「あらー、お気に召しませんでしたかー」
lines.english: “Oh. It does not appeal to you?”

lines.japanese: 「たりめーだろ。おまえ、俺のことなんだと思ってんだ」
lines.english: “Of course it doesn't. What the hell do you think I am?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そうですよねー、隼人さんやっぱり制服一筋ですよねー」
lines.english: “Ah, yes. Naturally, you are devoted exclusively to school uniforms.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ作業着フェチ」
lines.english: “Shut up, work-clothes fetishist.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、あれー、隼人さんはあれなんか似合うんじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “Oh, look. I think that one over there might suit you.”

lines.japanese: 「おい。おいドラ猫。聞けよ、ひとの話」
lines.english: “Hey. Hey, alley cat. Listen when somebody's talking to you.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、どーぞー」
lines.english: “Yes, go ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「あれー、なんだろあっちの黒いの。へー、吸血鬼になるガムだってー」
lines.english: “Oh, what's that black thing over there? How interesting. It says it's gum that turns you into a vampire.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょー、待ておい。こっち放ったらかしかよ」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, wait. You're just abandoning me?”

lines.japanese: 「ふぎゃー」
lines.english: “Fugyaa!”

lines.japanese: 鳴の頭からふざけた耳を引っこぬくと、やつはふざけた悲鳴をあげた。俺はそのケモノ耳を元あった棚に捨てた。
lines.english: I yanked the ridiculous ears off Naru's head, and she gave a ridiculous shriek. I tossed the animal ears back onto the shelf where they belonged.

lines.japanese: 客の少ない真夜中のディスカウントショップ。俺たちはパーティーグッズのクリスマス用特設コーナーで、数々のジョークアイテムに眉をひそめたり唇を吊りあげたりしていた。
lines.english: The discount store was nearly empty at midnight. In the party-goods aisle's special Christmas section, we frowned or grinned at one gag item after another.

lines.japanese: ついさっき日付が変わって、今日から１２月。店を飾っているのと同じツリーやリースやオーナメントが、書き入れ時を控えて最前線に駆りだされていた。
lines.english: The date had only just rolled over; today was the first of December. Trees, wreaths, and ornaments like the ones decorating the store had been deployed to the front lines for their busiest season.

lines.japanese: 「てかさ、おまえはいまいち猫って感じじゃねーよな」
lines.english: “You know, you don't really strike me as a cat.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、何って感じですかー」
lines.english: “Then what do I strike you as?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、なんつーか、もっと小動物系の……」
lines.english: “I dunno. Something more like a little animal…”

lines.japanese: 俺は売り場を見まわした。
lines.english: I looked around the aisle.

lines.japanese: 「あー、アレだ、ウサギとかじゃね？」
lines.english: “Oh. There you go. A rabbit, maybe?”

lines.japanese: 「バニー！」
lines.english: “A bunny girl!”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい、そうですねー、たしかに系統としてはそんな感じですよねー」
lines.english: “Yes, yes. I suppose that is broadly the right family.”

lines.japanese: 「だろ。ぜってー似合うって。も、はんぱねーって」
lines.english: “Right? It'd look perfect on you. Like, unbelievably perfect.”

lines.japanese: 「や、や、そんな、そこまでは似合わないと思うんですけどー」
lines.english: “Oh, no, no. I hardly think it would suit me that well.”

lines.japanese: 「なに謙遜してんだよ。俺が言ってんだから間違いねーんだよ。ハマるっておまえ、ちょっと着てみろよ」
lines.english: “What're you getting modest for? I said it, so it's true. You'd nail it. Go on, try it on.”

lines.japanese: 「いややや、いきなりそんな、いくら私でもさすがにそれは恥ずかしいですよー」
lines.english: “No, no, no. You can't spring that on me. Even I would be embarrassed.”

lines.japanese: 「なんでだよ。似合うんだからいいだろ。俺が見たいつってんだから見せろよ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Why? It'd suit you, so what's the problem? I wanna see it, so show me. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「やーですよう、もぉ、男の子なんだからこーいつぅー」
lines.english: “Oh, honestly—you are such a boy.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 俺は刀身が引っこむナイフで心臓を一突きされた。
lines.english: She stabbed me through the heart with a retractable toy knife.

lines.japanese: 「やー、でもー、隼人さんがちゃんと正常な性嗜好もお持ちだと判明してひと安心ですー」
lines.english: “Still, I'm relieved to learn that you possess some perfectly ordinary tastes as well.”

lines.japanese: 「……え、どゆこと」
lines.english: “…What's that supposed to mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ほら私ー、こんな普通の制服着てても匂いたつ色香は隠せないじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “After all, even dressed in an ordinary uniform like this, I cannot conceal the beguiling allure pouring off me.”

lines.japanese: 俺は思わず言葉を失ったので、代わりに笑い袋を押した。
lines.english: Words failed me, so I squeezed a canned-laughter bag instead.

lines.japanese: 「脱いだらすごいですよー」
lines.english: “You should see how impressive I am once the clothes come off.”

lines.japanese: 便利なアイテムだった。
lines.english: What a useful little device.

lines.japanese: 「あー、あのそう言えばー、ウサギって発情期が決まってなくて、いつでもどこでも、ふとした拍子にどんどこ子孫を残すらしいですよー」
lines.english: “Oh, speaking of rabbits, apparently they have no fixed mating season and will multiply anywhere, anytime, at the slightest opportunity.”

lines.japanese: 「へー」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 「あのー、提案があるんですけどー」
lines.english: “Um, I have a proposal.”

lines.japanese: 特設コーナーのワゴンや陳列棚をあらかたいじり終えたころ、鳴がなにやらちょっと改まった調子で俺の服を掴んだ。
lines.english: Once we’d finished pawing through most of the bins and shelves in the special display, Naru caught hold of my sleeve and addressed me in a suddenly formal tone.

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「あのー、クリスマスも近いことですしー、プレゼント交換をしませんか」
lines.english: “Since Christmas is close, would you like to exchange presents?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに？」
lines.english: “Huh? What?”

lines.japanese: いきなり脈絡のないことを言われた。いや、「クリスマスが近い」っていう脈絡があるのか。
lines.english: The suggestion came out of nowhere. No—perhaps Christmas being close did count as a lead-in.

lines.japanese: 突然ウサギの話とか、突然モナリザの話とかには対応できるようになったけど──ていうか、対応しないで流せるようになったけど、今回は中途半端なカッ飛びだったのでつっかえてしまった。
lines.english: I’d learned to cope when she suddenly started talking about rabbits or the Mona Lisa—or rather, learned to let it wash past unanswered. This time she’d only gone halfway off the rails, which somehow tripped me up.

lines.japanese: 「プレゼントですよう。お互いに相手の喜びそうなものを選んで、素敵なサプライズを交わしあうんです」
lines.english: “Presents. We each choose something we think the other person will enjoy, then give each other a lovely surprise.”

lines.japanese: 「なにおまえ、近々いなくなんの」
lines.english: “What, are you disappearing soon?”
“Excuse me?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ほら、映画とかで今生の別れっつー場面でそういうこと言いだすじゃん」
lines.english: “You know. In movies, people always suggest this kind of thing when they're about to part forever.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、もー、縁起でもないこと言わないでくださいよー、あなたを追ってどこまでもですよー」
lines.english: “Please don't say anything so ominous. I shall follow you to the ends of the earth.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そー」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんとなく思いついただけで、深い意味はありません」
lines.english: “The thought simply occurred to me. There is no deeper meaning.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん。まあ、面白そうだけど……」
lines.english: “Huh. Well, it sounds kind of fun...”

lines.japanese: 広大な２フロアに渡って節操なくいろんなモノが売られている店だ。パーティーグッズじゃなくてもネタになりそうな品は無数にありそうだし、どれを選ぶかのセンスも問われる。主にユーモアの。
lines.english: The store sprawled across two enormous floors and sold everything under the sun without a shred of restraint. Even outside the party-goods aisle, there had to be countless things we could turn into a joke. The choice would test our taste—mainly our sense of humor.

lines.japanese: 挑戦に応じても悪くはない。とは言え──
lines.english: Taking her up on the challenge might be fun. That said—

lines.japanese: 「いや、でもおまえ、終電」
lines.english: “Yeah, but your last train.”

lines.japanese: 俺はふたたび鳴の左腕を拾いあげた。しかしやつは、俺が時刻を確かめるより先に、もう一方の手で盤面を塞いでしまった。
lines.english: I lifted Naru’s left wrist again. Before I could check the time, she covered the watch face with her other hand.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、今日のところは大目に見てやってもらえまえせんかねー」
lines.english: “Could you perhaps overlook the matter just for tonight?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「たまの夜遊びということでひとつ」
lines.english: “Consider it one rare night out.”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「しょーがねえな、今日だけだぞ。俺がパルさんに怒られんだからな」
lines.english: “Fine. But only tonight. I'm the one Paru will chew out for this.”

lines.japanese: 「はいっ、ありがとうございます」
lines.english: “Yes! Thank you very much.”

lines.japanese: 「おし。じゃあそうと決まれば……」
lines.english: “All right. Now that that's settled...”

lines.japanese: 俺はこぶしを鳴らして店の中を見渡した。
lines.english: I cracked my knuckles and surveyed the store.

lines.japanese: 「二十分後、買った品を持って店の前に集合」
lines.english: “Twenty minutes from now, meet out front with whatever you bought.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー、受けて立ちますよー」
lines.english: “Very well. I accept your challenge.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、受けたの俺なんだけど」
lines.english: “I'm the one who accepted yours.”

lines.japanese: 商品が天井近くまでうずたかく積まれた圧縮陳列の中を、見たり読んだり触れたりしながら歩いた。
lines.english: I moved through the dense maze of merchandise stacked almost to the ceiling, looking, reading, and touching as I went.

lines.japanese: さて、どう攻めるか。
lines.english: Now. How to approach this?

lines.japanese: 一発ネタならアダルトグッズ売り場に何かしかくだらないのが転がってそうだけど、見せあうだけじゃなくてちゃんと金を払って贈るわけだからな、いくらかでも実用性のあるものの方がいいだろう。
lines.english: If I only wanted one cheap laugh, there was probably something idiotic lying around the adult-novelty aisle. But we weren't merely showing the things to each other; we were paying real money and giving them as presents. Something with at least a little practical value would be better.

lines.japanese: 使えるもので、見た目ちょっと笑えて、だけどやつが少しは喜びそうなもの。
lines.english: Something useful. Something that looked a little ridiculous. Something she might actually be pleased to receive.

lines.japanese: はて、なんだろう。
lines.english: What could that be?

lines.japanese: ……健康食品？
lines.english: ...Health food?

lines.japanese: くそ、考えてみると意外に難しいな。そういや俺は、いままで女に贈りものなんてしたことがなかった。
lines.english: Damn. Once I stopped to think about it, this was harder than I’d expected. Come to think of it, I’d never given a woman a present in my life.

lines.japanese: 貴金属売り場のショウケースに、頭がワイルドなことになってるヤンキーカップルが張りついていた。一瞬立ちどまったものの、俺にしても鳴にしても金だの銀だのはガラじゃないのですぐに通りすぎた。
lines.english: A delinquent-looking couple with aggressively sculpted hair was plastered to a display case in the jewelry section. I stopped for an instant, but neither Naru nor I was made for gold or silver, so I moved on.

lines.japanese: ＣＤ売り場に差しかかったが、やはりここも素通りした。プレゼントとしちゃ無難なんだろうけど、俺は流行りの音楽とかに明るくないし、かと言って普遍的な名作なら詳しいってわけでもない。
lines.english: I reached the CDs and passed those too. Music was probably a safe present, but I knew nothing about whatever was popular—and it wasn't as though I knew the timeless classics either.

lines.japanese: ひと一人に贈り物をするって、結構な頭脳労働なんだな。
lines.english: Giving one person a present was serious mental labor.
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 日曜大工用品の売り場で、ラジオペンチを昔の駅員みたいにかちかちさせながら考えていたら、照明器具コーナーから抜けだしてきた鳴と鉢合わせした。
lines.english: I was in the DIY aisle, thinking as I clicked a pair of needle-nose pliers like an old-time stationmaster, when I ran into Naru emerging from the lighting section.

lines.japanese: 「おう、どーよ。そっち、もう決まったの」
lines.english: “Hey. How's it going? Picked yours yet?”

lines.japanese: かちかちかちかち。
lines.english: Click, click, click, click.

lines.japanese: 「あー、いえ、まだなんですけど丁度よかったですー」
lines.english: “No, not yet. But this is perfect timing.”

lines.japanese: やつはそう言って、俺の正面に──まさにきっちり真正面に立った。
lines.english: With that, she stood directly in front of me—exactly, squarely in front.

lines.japanese: 「気を付け」
lines.english: “Attention.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 俺は苦い顔をしながらも、つい反射的に両腕を脇へ付けて背筋を伸ばしていた。
lines.english: I grimaced, but reflexively snapped my arms to my sides and straightened my spine.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに」
lines.english: “What is this?”

lines.japanese: 「いえいえー、そのままそのまま」
lines.english: “Nothing, nothing. Stay exactly like that.”

lines.japanese: にへらにへらと笑いながら、鳴は棒立ちした俺の裏に回りこんで、べたべた体を触っていった。
lines.english: Grinning foolishly, Naru circled behind me and began patting and prodding me all over.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、何してんだよ」
lines.english: “Hey, what are you doing?”

lines.japanese: 「あーもー、動かないでください」
lines.english: “Oh, please hold still.”

lines.japanese: 振りむこうとしたら、後ろから頭を押さえられた。
lines.english: When I tried to turn, she held my head in place from behind.

lines.japanese: 「ただの採寸ですよー」
lines.english: “I am merely taking measurements.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 仕方なく、俺は足元へ目を落とした。電動ドライバーの箱が、うっすら埃をかぶってかすかに色褪せていた。何度も業者間転売を繰りかえした末にここへ辿りついたのかもしれない。
lines.english: With no alternative, I lowered my eyes to the floor. A box containing an electric screwdriver sat under a film of dust, its colors faintly faded. Perhaps it had passed from wholesaler to wholesaler before finally washing ashore here.

lines.japanese: かちかちかちかち。
lines.english: Click, click, click, click.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、おまえさ、なんか欲しいモンねーの」
lines.english: “Hey. Is there anything you actually want?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでも構いませんよー」
lines.english: “Anything at all is fine.”

lines.japanese: 鳴が正面に戻ってきた。むやみに楽しそうだった。
lines.english: Naru came around to face me, looking far too delighted with herself.

lines.japanese: 「はい、お疲れさまでしたー。それではまた後ほどー」
lines.english: “There we are. Thank you for your cooperation. I shall see you later.”

lines.japanese: そう言いのこしてやつは去った。
lines.english: With that, she walked away.

lines.japanese: 俺はひとり食品売り場へ足を運んだ。
lines.english: I went alone to the food section.

lines.japanese: あいつが好きなものと言ったら、思いうかぶのがまず細々とした菓子類だ。
lines.english: When I thought of things she liked, the first things that came to mind were sweets and snacks.

lines.japanese: 「どうよコレ」
lines.english: “How about this?”

lines.japanese: 俺は割れチョコがたっぷり詰まった徳用袋を手に取って考えた。
lines.english: I picked up a value bag crammed with broken chocolate and considered it.

lines.japanese: んー、間違ってはいないと思うんだけど、なんつーか華がない。もっと高級感のある、デパ地下で売ってるようなブランドもののチョコにした方がいいんだろうか。
lines.english: Hmm. It wasn’t wrong, exactly, but it had no charm. Maybe I should buy some luxury chocolate from a department-store food hall.

lines.japanese: でも、そうすると今度は華があり過ぎる。つまり面白みに欠ける。なんか本気っぽくて赤面しそうだ。
lines.english: But that swung too far the other way. It wouldn’t be funny at all. It would feel too sincere, and I’d probably blush.

lines.japanese: お菓子っていう方向性はいいとして、ただこう、もうちょっと遊び心のある──
lines.english: Sweets were the right direction. I just needed something with a little more mischief to it—

lines.japanese: ──おっ、あれなんかどうだ？
lines.english: —oh. What about that?

lines.japanese: 「えー、それではー、第一回プレゼント交換会ーどんどんぱふぱふー」
lines.english: “And now, the inaugural Present Exchange! Drumroll and fanfare!”

lines.japanese: 集合時間になったので店から出てみると、俺はまばらな拍手で迎えられた。鳴の大袈裟な身振りに合わせて、フレイムバーズの連中まで遠巻きに手を叩いていた（叩くな）。
lines.english: When I emerged at the appointed time, scattered applause greeted me. Matching Naru's grand gestures, even the Flame Birds clapped from a distance. Stop that.

lines.japanese: 「ではまず私からー。はい、どーぞー」
lines.english: “I shall go first. Here you are.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、はい、どうも」
lines.english: “Oh. Right. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 先に鳴が、両腕の肘から下にすっぽり載るぐらいの包みを渡してきた。礼を言って受けとると、包装紙の中はふにゃりとした柔らかな──布の感触がした。
lines.english: Naru handed me a package that fit neatly across both her forearms. I thanked her and took it. Beneath the wrapping was something limp and soft—the feel of cloth.

lines.japanese: 「開けていいの」
lines.english: “Can I open it?”

lines.japanese: 「ぜひぜひ」
lines.english: “By all means.”

lines.japanese: いちおう確認してから、俺は包みを乱暴に解いた。中からくすんだ象牙色の生地が見えた──と思ったら、鳴の手が伸びてきてそれを掴んだ。
lines.english: After checking that I could, I tore the wrapping open without ceremony. Dull ivory fabric appeared—or began to, before Naru reached in and seized it.

lines.japanese: 「じゃーん！」
lines.english: “Ta-da!”

lines.japanese: やつが体の前に広げたのは、やけに見慣れた色の作業着だった。
lines.english: Naru spread out a set of work clothes in a color I knew far too well.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、さんきゅ……」
lines.english: “Oh. Right. Thanks...”

lines.japanese: おまえコレ自分の趣味じゃねえか、とツッコミそうになったけど、いや、たぶんやつなりの厚意なんだろう。俺は素直に礼を述べた。
lines.english: I nearly pointed out that she’d chosen a gift to suit her own tastes. But no. It was probably sincere kindness in her own way. I thanked her honestly.

lines.japanese: 「いや、助かるわ。もう一着、洗濯用に代えが欲しいと思ってたし」
lines.english: “This actually helps. I’d been wanting a spare set for when the other one’s in the wash.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー、そうじゃないかと思ったんですよー」
lines.english: “Yes. I thought you might.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう、マジで。すげえなおまえ、気ィ利くじゃん。サトリじゃん。サトリのオオトリ、語呂もいいじゃん」
lines.english: “Seriously? Damn, you’re thoughtful. Like a mind reader. Otori the Oracle—hell, it even sounds good.”

lines.japanese: 「でもアレだな。いいんだけど、なんかコレ、いま俺が持ってんのと似てんな」
lines.english: “Still, these look an awful lot like the ones I already have.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー、いろんな種類あったんですけどー、職場の決まりとかあったら困りますので、無難な選択を取らせていただきましたー」
lines.english: “Yes. There were all kinds, but I thought your workplace might have rules, so I played it safe.”

lines.japanese: 「ほらー、青系だと内装工事のひとみたいだしー、ニッカポッカだと大工さんみたいじゃないですかー。私その辺まだよく分からないのでー」
lines.english: “The blue ones make you look like an interior contractor, and those baggy work pants make you look like a carpenter. I don’t understand all the distinctions yet.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー、俺バイトだから何でもいいんだけどさ」
lines.english: “Well, I’m only a part-timer, so anything would’ve been fine.”

lines.japanese: 「や、でもマジさんきゅ。贈り主の妙な性癖を疑って一瞬だけ引いちゃったけど、勘弁な」
lines.english: “But seriously, thanks. Sorry I recoiled for a second and wondered what weird kink the giver had.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー、喜んでいただけて幸いですー。いま着ていただいても結構ですよー」
lines.english: “I'm glad you like them. You may put them on right now, if you like.”

lines.japanese: 「いまってここでかよ。いや、それはないだろ、さすがに」
lines.english: “Right now? Here? No. That's asking a little much.”

lines.japanese: 「いえー、ありですよー。遠慮しなくて結構ですからー」
lines.english: “Oh, it is perfectly acceptable. You needn't be shy.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、遠慮とかじゃなくて……」
lines.english: “It ain't about being shy…”

lines.japanese: しかし鳴は真剣な表情で、両手の作業着をゆっくり前に突きだした。
lines.english: But Naru's face turned solemn as she slowly extended the work clothes in both hands.

lines.japanese: 「さあ」
lines.english: “Now.”

lines.japanese: そして一歩踏みだした。
lines.english: She took one step toward me.

lines.japanese: 「着るんだ」
lines.english: “Put them on.”

lines.japanese: 「さかるなッての」
lines.english: “Quit going into heat.”

lines.japanese: 「はふん」
lines.english: “Hafun.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの額を叩いて押しもどした。そして作業着を没収した。
lines.english: I flicked her forehead, pushed her back, and confiscated the work clothes.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあコレ、ありがたくもらっとくわ。どーもな」
lines.english: “Anyway, I'll gladly take these. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「あーそだそだ。隼人さん、これおまけですー」
lines.english: “Oh, that's right. Hayato, these are a little bonus.”

lines.japanese: 正気を取りもどした鳴が、べつのポリ袋を差しだしてきた。
lines.english: Restored to her senses, Naru offered me a separate plastic bag.

lines.japanese: 「特売中だったので思わず買ってしまいましたー」
lines.english: “They were on sale, and I bought them before I knew it.”

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese: 袋の口を開けて覗いてみた。スニーカータイプの安全靴と、真っ白なタオル、それに軍手がいくつか入っていた。
lines.english: I opened the bag and looked inside. Sneaker-style safety shoes, a pristine white towel, and several pairs of work gloves.

lines.japanese: 俺は顔を上げて、キツ過ぎない声で言った。
lines.english: I raised my face and spoke without making my voice too harsh.

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえこんな……買いすぎだろ」
lines.english: “Come on, this is... You bought way too much.”

lines.japanese: 「いえー、ほんとに安かったんでー」
lines.english: “No, it truly was very inexpensive.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そう？」
lines.english: “Oh. Yeah?”

lines.japanese: お嬢の言う「安い」ってどのくらいなんだろう、なんてふと思った。
lines.english: I found myself wondering what counted as ‘inexpensive’ to a rich girl.

lines.japanese: 「お仕事ばりばりがんばってくださいねー」
lines.english: “Please work very, very hard at your job.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、まあ、こういうの欲しかったかも」
lines.english: “Yeah. Actually, I might've wanted things like this.”

lines.japanese: 剥き出しの安全靴を片方ポリ袋から出して、手の甲へ爪先を数回押しあてた。見かけは普通のスニーカーなのに、先端は鉄芯が入っていて痛いぐらいに硬かった。
lines.english: I pulled one unboxed safety shoe from the bag and pressed its toe against the back of my hand a few times. It looked like an ordinary sneaker, but the steel cap made the tip painfully hard.

lines.japanese: それから軽くタオルを首にかけて、軍手を片方だけはめてみた。
lines.english: Then I draped the towel loosely around my neck and tried on one work glove.

lines.japanese: 「どうよ。こんな感じ？」
lines.english: “How's this? About right?”

lines.japanese: 「す、素敵です」
lines.english: “W-wonderful.”

lines.japanese: やつは手の甲で口元を拭う身振りをしながら、うっすらと笑った。
lines.english: She made a show of wiping the corner of her mouth with the back of her hand, a faint smile on her lips.

lines.japanese: 俺はちょっぴり背筋が凍った。
lines.english: A tiny chill ran down my spine.

lines.japanese: 「ついでに鳳鳴ちゃんさんのサインも入れましょうかー」
lines.english: “Shall I add the autograph of the illustrious Lady Naru Otori herself while we're at it?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、いい」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「まーまー、そんな遠慮なさらずー」
lines.english: “Now, now. No need to be so modest.”

lines.japanese: 「ああっ、ばかやめろ、汚ねぇ字で落書きすんな」
lines.english: “Hey! Idiot, stop. Don't scribble on them with your terrible handwriting.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの手から油性ペンを取りあげ、もらったものを袋へ戻した。
lines.english: I took the permanent marker from her and returned the gifts to their bag.

lines.japanese: 「あ……ああ、そうだ。忘れてた。俺からはコレ」
lines.english: “Oh... Right. Almost forgot. Here’s mine.”

lines.japanese: そして気を取りなおし、さっき買って、軽くラップしてもらったものを鳴に渡した。
lines.english: Pulling myself together, I handed Naru what I’d bought and had wrapped for me.

lines.japanese: 「わーい、ありがとうございまーす」
lines.english: “Hooray! Thank you very much.”

lines.japanese: やつは幼い子供の真似をするように両手を上げた。
lines.english: She threw both hands up like a little kid.

lines.japanese: それから、うはうは言いながら包みを解いた。俺は相手がどう反応するのか見守りながら待った。
lines.english: Then she tore into the package with delighted little noises. I waited, watching for her reaction.
“Ho.”

lines.japanese: 中身が見えると、やつは尖った唇の隙間から短い声を漏らした。
lines.english: When she saw what was inside, a short sound escaped through her pursed lips.

lines.japanese: 「ほっほー！」
lines.english: “Ho-ho!”
—A cat.

lines.japanese: 菓子売り場のいわゆる食玩が並んだ棚に、ひとつだけ売れのこっていた猫。ちなみに対象年齢は３歳以上らしい。
lines.english: On the snack aisle’s shelf of candy toys, one solitary cat had been left unsold. Recommended for ages three and up, incidentally.

lines.japanese: 「それ、アレだから。ぬいぐるみじゃないから」
lines.english: “Just so you know, that isn't a stuffed animal.”

lines.japanese: 「は、そうなんですか？」
lines.english: “Oh. It isn't?”

lines.japanese: 「そ、菓子入れだから。中にアメちゃん入ってっから」
lines.english: “Nope. It’s a candy holder. There’s candy inside.”

lines.japanese: 「あらあらあら」
lines.english: “My, my, my.”

lines.japanese: 鳴は猫の背中をジッパーで裂いて、その奥に個別包装されたキャンディを見つけた。
lines.english: Naru split the cat's back with its zipper and discovered individually wrapped candies tucked inside.

lines.japanese: 「あはは、かーわいー」
lines.english: “Ha ha. How adorable.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、でも悪りぃな。菓子売り場ン中じゃべらぼうに高かったんだけど、ちょっと作業着とじゃ釣りあわねーかもな」
lines.english: “Sorry, though. It was absurdly expensive for something in the candy aisle, but it still doesn’t come close to the work clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「いえー、とんでもないですー」
lines.english: “Oh, not at all.”

lines.japanese: 「そかー、隼人さんから見ると、私ってこういう普通に可愛いのが似合うキャラなんだー」
lines.english: “I see. So when you look at me, you think plain old cute things like this suit me.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。いちいちひねるな。普通に喜べ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Quit twisting everything. Just be happy like a normal person.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人さんってー、たぶん同棲したら彼女の歯ブラシ、迷わずピンクいの買ってくるタイプですよねー」
lines.english: “If you ever lived with a girlfriend, I suspect you would buy her a pink toothbrush without a moment's hesitation.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせっつんだよ。男はブルー女はピンク、昔っからそう決まってんだろが。文句あんのかコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “I said shut up. Blue for men, pink for women. That's how it's always been. You got a problem with that?”

lines.japanese: 「えへー、ありがとうございます。これ大事にしますねー」
lines.english: “Heh. Thank you. I shall treasure it.”

lines.japanese: 鳴は俺を無視して、贈り物の猫を後ろから両腕でハグした。
lines.english: Ignoring me, Naru wrapped both arms around the cat from behind.

lines.japanese: 「お、おう」
lines.english: “R-right.”

lines.japanese: 子供みたいで、予想外に似合ってる。俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: She looked like a child, and the cat suited her better than I’d expected. I scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、俺も……もらったもん大事に着させてもらうし？」
lines.english: “Well, I’ll... wear what you gave me and take good care of it too. Yeah?”

lines.japanese: やつは俺の言ってることを聞いてるんだか聞いてないんだか、顔を横に倒してほっぺたを猫の頭頂部にくっつけていた。
lines.english: Whether she heard me or not, Naru tilted her head and pressed one cheek to the crown of the cat's head.

lines.japanese: 「んー、もーこれ、毎日持ちあるっちゃおーかなー」
lines.english: “Mmm. Maybe I’ll carry this with me every day.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それは」
lines.english: “No, that's...”

lines.japanese: 対象年齢３歳以上だから。
lines.english: It was for ages three and up, after all.
